# Charybdis 4x6 default keymap (QMK)

`keymap.json` is copied unchanged from
https://github.com/qmk/qmk_firmware/blob/180f394b489c238cb231c2bf8b080262155e03c0/keyboards/bastardkb/charybdis/4x6/keymaps/default/keymap.json
(the commit the `bastardkb/charybdis-4x6` board pins). It is QMK's stock keymap in the Configurator format, with no keymap.c beside it.
QMK is GPL-2.0-or-later, which keyloom's AGPL-3.0-or-later can include; its licence is `LICENSE` here.
